ic_name: MIPI D-PHY / CSI-2 (TI SLLA414 application note)
opcode_synthesis_skipped_reason: L2.protocol_overview.half_duplex is not True and no explicit opcode/command-table heading was found in input/docs/. Free-form hex bytes in prose, SVG labels, or PDF text do not constitute opcode evidence.
protocol_type: Packet-based source→sink streaming protocol on top of source-synchronous DDR physical layer; each packet is self-identifying via a 6-bit Data Type encoded inside the 4-byte header. CSI-2 has no opcode/register protocol — only image-data carrying packets + frame/line sync short packets.

channels.name: CLK_P / CLK_N
channels.direction: source → sink (HS); both ends idle LP-11 between bursts
channels.purpose: Differential DDR Clock Lane; both edges latch one bit per Data Lane.

channels.name: DAT0_P / DAT0_N
channels.purpose: Differential Data Lane 0; carries CSI-2 packet bytes during HS.

channels.name: DAT1..DAT3 (optional)
channels.purpose: Additional Data Lanes for higher bandwidth; interleave bytes round-robin across lanes.

packet_classes.purpose: Carries image-data payload (RAW/YUV/RGB/generic). Has header + payload + CRC-16 footer.
packet_classes.header_layout: DI (1 byte) + WC[15:0] Word Count (2 bytes) + ECC (1 byte) — total 32 bits.
packet_classes.payload_layout: WC bytes of image data, byte-interleaved across N Data Lanes when N > 1.
packet_classes.footer_layout: 16-bit CRC-16 over payload bytes only (polynomial 0x1021, init 0xFFFF, MSB-first).

packet_classes.purpose: Frame / line synchronization markers and generic short signaling. No payload, no footer.
packet_classes.header_layout: DI (1 byte) + Data[15:0] (2 bytes; e.g. frame number for FS) + ECC (1 byte) — total 32 bits.

data_identifier_byte.structure: DI = { VC[1:0] : DT[5:0] } in v1.1 (4 VCs); DI = { VC[3:0] (split across reserved bits) : DT[5:0] } in v1.2+ (16 VCs via VC extension).

data_types_enum.generic_short_packets: DT 0x08..0x0F reserved for generic short packets (vendor-defined Data[15:0]).
data_types_enum.generic_long_packets: DT 0x30..0x37 reserved for user-defined 8-bit data (long packets).

header_ecc_field.structure: Extended Hamming(8,4): 6 parity bits over 24 data bits (DI + WC[7:0] + WC[15:8]) + 2 extra bits for double-bit detect.

payload_crc_field.covers: Long Packet payload bytes only (does NOT cover header).

transaction_phases: HS Entry — source drives LP-11 → LP-01 → LP-00 → HS-0 → Sync pattern 8'b00011101.
Packet Stream — one or more Long / Short Packets back-to-back on HS payload (header → payload → footer per Long Packet).
Optional Escape — LP-11 → LP-10 → LP-00 → escape-pattern for ULPS / Trigger / Reset.

addressing.device_address: None — CSI-2 is strictly point-to-point source→sink; one transmitter + one receiver per physical interface.
addressing.VC_role: Time-multiplex multiple logical streams (e.g. left + right sensor) onto the same physical D-PHY.

valid_ready_handshake_rules: There is no ACK / NAK / retry — CSI-2 is one-way source→sink streaming.
HS Entry sync pattern (8'b00011101) marks start of payload; receiver locks here.
Header ECC validates DI + WC; corrupt headers are dropped silently (after correction or detect).
Payload CRC-16 mismatch is reported to upper layers but does not trigger retransmission — host application decides.
LP-11 Stop state separates bursts; LP-Contention is an error case detected by both endpoints.
